definitions.gloss: sense of immersion; immersive feeling; feeling of being absorbed
definitions.explanation: The feeling of being completely drawn into an experience, especially in gaming, virtual reality, film, or other media. A buzzword in technology and entertainment.

examples.japanese: {没入感|ぼつにゅうかん}がすごい。
examples.english: The sense of immersion is amazing.

examples.japanese: このゲームは{没入感|ぼつにゅうかん}が{高|たか}い。
examples.english: This game has a high level of immersion.

examples.japanese: VRヘッドセットを{使|つか}うと、{圧倒的|あっとうてき}な{没入感|ぼつにゅうかん}を{体験|たいけん}できる。
examples.english: With a VR headset, you can experience an overwhelming sense of immersion.

notes:
A compound of {没入|ぼつにゅう} (immersion, being absorbed) and {感|かん} (feeling, sense). Has become very common in discussions about gaming, VR, movies, and other media experiences. {没入|ぼつにゅう} itself combines {没|ぼつ} (sink, submerge) and {入|にゅう} (enter).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {没入感|ぼつにゅうかん}が{高|たか}い — highly immersive
- {没入感|ぼつにゅうかん}を{味|あじ}わう — to savor the immersion
- {没入感|ぼつにゅうかん}を{損|そこ}なう — to break the immersion
- {没入感|ぼつにゅうかん}のある{体験|たいけん} — an immersive experience

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {臨場感|りんじょうかん} — sense of presence, being-there feeling
- {現実感|げんじつかん} — sense of reality
- {一体感|いったいかん} — sense of unity, oneness
